fox-blighted.prompt: Edit the approved leaftail sheet into its Blighted form. Preserve four columns, six rows, idle front/back/right with two occupied cells; walk front/back/right with four. Ash grey fur, warm grey cream muzzle, smoky violet brown outline, dull pale grey eyes, sad and tired, faint small cracks. No wounds, frightening teeth, red eyes, accessories or ground shadow. Transparent background.
fox-blighted.note: Generated alpha was not transparent. Flooded the pale border background before normal alpha cleanup, palette snap and fit. Approved original sheets remain unchanged.

heartstone.prompt: Two-column HUD icon sheet, chunky cozy pixel RPG style. Left: upright pale Heartstone with teal crystal inset in an aged brass circular base with seven notches. heartstone.processing: Crop left half to assets-src/raw/heartstone-3.png; bun tools/sprites/build-story-extra.mjs heartstone

mark.prompt: One standalone cozy pixel RPG HUD icon. Magical teal hollow ring with exactly seven evenly spaced outward triangular tips at 12:00, 1:43, 3:26, 5:09, 6:51, 8:34, 10:17. No bottom-center tip. Emblem only, top tip pale mint, other six subdued teal. Warm top-left light, tinted brown outline, transparent background, no haze or text. Designed for 24x24 within 32x32 cell.
mark.note: First hand-and-ring attempt had eight points and was rejected. Shipped standalone ring has seven points.
